metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Ivy Longribbon
records.biography_en: Ivy Longribbon joins The Estate Committee as wreath maker. “Leave enough ribbon for the name.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small oval wreath with extra ribbon rolled in one goo hand.

records.name: Bram Smallbequest
records.biography_en: Bram Smallbequest joins The Estate Committee as heir with a small inheritance. “It feels heavier than it looks.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny sealed parcel held close in both hands.

records.name: Faye Indexcards
records.biography_en: Faye Indexcards joins The Estate Committee as speaker keeping notes out of the wind. “Hold the top one, please.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: three large cards with one edge curled upward.

records.name: Alf Obituary
records.biography_en: Alf Obituary joins The Estate Committee as deliberate obituary editor. “The final sentence needs a comma.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: folded blank obituary proof with large pencil.

records.name: Perry Willfold
records.biography_en: Perry Willfold joins The Estate Committee as keeper of a slightly confusing will. “Which copy says who gets the lamp?”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: rolled cream folio tied with a blunt wax seal.

records.name: Wes Keepsake
records.biography_en: Wes Keepsake joins The Estate Committee as quiet keepsake bearer. “I remember the coat.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny portrait locket held open at belly with a simple abstract silhouette.
